story.title: Paytm Posts First-Ever Annual Profit of Rs 552 Crore in FY26 After Years of Losses
story.summary: Digital payments leader Paytm has recorded its first-ever full-year net profit of Rs 552 crore in FY26, swinging from significant losses in prior years. The turnaround was driven by disciplined cost control and a 22% rise in operating revenue to Rs 8,437 crore, with financial services emerging as the primary growth engine. The milestone is significant for India's fintech sector, signalling that large-scale digital payments platforms can achieve sustainable profitability after extended investment phases.
